Senses.Explanation: Aparagodaniya, the western continent — the borrowed far edge of the world that the masters drum from, shoot at, sail to, and shuffle out of its seat. Yunmen Wenyan sets the frame at his address to the assembly — sun and moon shine slantwise on three continents and straight on four — then, saying he has it glossed for them, demands the sentence, and answers in their stead: eastern continent... western continent; Wuzu Fayan, styling himself the White Cloud elder, raises his hand and makes a Buddha of the whole apparatus — the twenty-eight heavens for a head, the golden wheel's waters for feet, the four continents for a body — then makes a second model: each continent a Buddha, grass and trees a Buddha, all moving and breathing a Buddha — and hands each thing back to itself, dharmas abiding in their positions, the world's marks ever present; Yuanwu Keqin shrinks the great square beyond-outside into a millet grain and the whole void into a palm-leaf, drags Silla and Champa to butt heads, and shoots: arrow loosed in the eastern body-continent, target struck in Aparagodaniya; and Linquan Conglun, appraising the case of hiding in the Dipper, simply glosses the geography — four continents on Sumeru's four faces, east, south, west, north, these the Sanskrit sounds — then asks where the Dipper hides its body, knocking the forehead in vain, searching in vain. Sanyi Mingyu presses the one-body question at general discourse — everywhere is one thing only, so why does this southern continent not know the northern continent's business, the eastern Poverty-goddess land not know Aparagodaniya's, the lower floors not know the Joy heavens? — then whisks raised, kneads the four continents into one lump, east and west indistinguishable, the western meaning the eastern meaning; Qianshan Shengren Hanke, seeing the Zhao brothers' family off to a new temple in Liaoyang, works the farewell verse through the borrowed map — gate and hall crossing places, pillars and lanterns swapping seats, the northern continent ringing its bell, Aparagodaniya's dogs barking, Indra's palace shaken, the eastern sea's carp at boil — and still the waves calm, the green hills and waters as before; Shitian Faxun spends eight graphs at the hall address — eastern continent, western continent; clear clear water, the swimming fish themselves lost; and Yulin Tongxiu, closing the retreat, runs the whole tour — sitting cross-legged in the southern continent, legs gone numb in the northern, bowl in hand in the eastern, arms aching in the western — then turns over on the ocean floor, knocks down Tushita's palace, tweaks the nose of old Yama until the four great kings sneeze in chorus, and warns: failing that, grass the moment you step out the door — mind your feet.
